gap_rule: oss_repos_exposing >= 3 and oss_coverage >= 0.15 and tensorsph src hits == 0

proposals.goal: Domain-decomposed multi-rank execution with halo particle exchange.
proposals.acceptance_quantified: Same dam-break case (tank 2.0 m, column 0.2x0.4 m, dx = 0.04 m, 0.5 s) on 2 and 4 ranks reproduces the 1-rank front trajectory to <= 1e-10 in the dimensionless front Z/a, and wall-clock speed-up >= 1.5x at 4 ranks.
proposals.rationale: MPI is claimed by DualSPHysics, GPUSPH, SWIFT, ChaNGa, SPHERAL and OpenFOAM-dev; this repository has no distributed path (probe: 0 source hits), so every resolution ladder is bounded by one node.

proposals.goal: Density-invariant incompressible SPH (DFSPH or ISPH projection) alongside the WCSPH path.
proposals.acceptance_quantified: On the existing Poiseuille channel benchmark (H/dx in {8,12,16}, same body force and nu): density fluctuation max|rho/rho0 - 1| <= 1e-3 (WCSPH today reports ~2.3e-2 in the same run), centre velocity within 3% of gH^2/(8 nu), and wall-shear budget closure D/(M g) within 3%.
proposals.rationale: Half the surveyed codes (SPlisHSPlasH, salva, ISPH CUDA, JAX-SPH) solve pressure with a projection step; the WCSPH acoustic floor documented in docs/verification_startup_quiescence.md (§5, 0.0208 m/s resting noise) is exactly what the projection removes, so this is the single largest accuracy lever.

proposals.goal: Akinci volume-weighted boundary particles as an alternative to the Adami extrapolation.
proposals.acceptance_quantified: Hydrostatic column, H/dx in {8,12,16}: bottom pressure within 3% of rho0 g H and worst interior-layer error within 5%, versus the current Adami baseline recorded in benchmarks/verification_ledger/ledger.json (threed_hydrostatic.bottom_pressure.adami_best = -2.75%, worst layer 43.2%).
proposals.rationale: Akinci boundary treatment is claimed by DualSPHysics, GPUSPH and SPlisHSPlasH; the ledger's worst interior-layer error (43%) is a boundary-layer artefact that the volume-weighted formulation is designed to remove.

proposals.goal: A genuine two-phase (density-discontinuous) SPH formulation, not a colour-smoothed single phase.
proposals.acceptance_quantified: On the existing two-phase Laplace benchmark: dp = sigma/R within 5% at dx = 2.5 mm with the interface density jump resolved (rho_1/rho_2 = 1000/1), and total mass of each phase conserved to <= 1e-12 relative over 0.1 s; the current single-phase smoothed-colour entry is 4.61% (two_phase_laplace.smoothed_colour.dx2.5mm in the verification ledger) but carries no second phase at all.
proposals.rationale: Multiphase appears in three surveyed codes (SPlisHSPlasH, DualSPHysics, SPHinXsys). This repository's probe finds no multiphase source: the two-phase Laplace benchmark smooths a colour field inside one phase, which cannot represent an air-water density jump.

proposals.goal: Sub-particle-scale (SPS) turbulence closure, gated by a resolvable analytic case.
proposals.acceptance_quantified: On the existing 3-D Taylor-Green shear benchmark: with the SPS term on, the measured decay exponent stays inside the current MARGINAL band of the ledger entry threed_shear.decay_rate.worst_of_ladder (-12.6% vs analytic) and the SPS stress vanishes (< 1e-12) for a uniform-strain field.
proposals.rationale: LES/SPS is claimed by DualSPHysics, GPUSPH and others; this repository states in src/tensorsph/freesurface/breaking_wave.py that its only turbulence model is artificial viscosity, which cannot be calibrated against data.
